headline: USC Upstate scores most and concedes least
dek: USC Upstate has scored 44 goals and conceded 17 across all its matches, winning 12 and losing three. Its only conference defeat came at home to Radford, the side directly beneath it in the table.

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: Goals and standing move together here: every program above High Point in the table has also outscored it, and High Point has outscored every program below it.

wire.line: No matches remain; Big South programs finished with 25 wins, thirteen draws, and 40 losses against non-conference opponents.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Seven matches past their date have no published result, every one of them scheduled in August, before conference play opened.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: UNC Asheville has drawn six matches, more than any other program in the conference.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: London Phoenix has kept six shutouts in goal for UNC Asheville.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Liana Bryant has scored ten goals from 62 shots for USC Upstate.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: USC Upstate's conference win over Radford was a forfeit; the only time the two sides met on the field, Radford won at USC Upstate.

last_match.line: The defeat ends UNC Asheville's unbeaten run since October and closes the conference's season.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
